statement: NVIDIA will be the exclusive AI compute infrastructure provider at the PORTS-Pike campus, with SB Energy building, owning and operating the data center for OpenAI
why: Exclusivity at a site of this size locks a competitor out of gigawatts of already-permitted power, which is currently the scarcest input in the chain.

impact.mechanism: An exclusivity guarantee ties a specific powered site to one vendor's accelerators, converting scarce power capacity into a locked-in design win and foreclosing alternative silicon at that site.

evidence.excerpt: AI is becoming infrastructure - the foundation for intelligence in every industry - and land, power and shell have become vital in the age of AI.

confidence.basis: Stated in NVIDIA's own press release, which is the authoritative source for its own commercial arrangement.
